review:
Bigger Bass Blizzard – Christmas Catch freezes the lake and moves the series to a taller 5x4 grid. Rods and reels get a winter makeover, and snowmobiles join the symbol set. The extra row gives more room for fish and fishermen to appear together.

Three or more scatters unlock free spins, where instant cash prizes on fish are collected by the fisherman wild. As usual, you need four fishermen to progress to the next level, which retriggers the spins and increases the collection multiplier. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win figure on the game's page. It's a sensible seasonal pick, and the 5x4 layout makes it play slightly differently from the 5x3 originals.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
